'''Polanis''' was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], within the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]]. It was known for the [[Polanis ale]] and the [[Polanis Wine]] produced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].
